classification.difficultyReason: Select a trigonometric ratio and rearrange it to find a side, including an unknown denominator.

content.prompt: Find the value of each pronumeral, correct to 4 decimal places.

questionDiagrams.code:
% mathsmap-diagram-colours {"version":1,"kind":"geometry","base":[],"semantic":[],"reference":"page 12 question 7a"}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont,line width=0.8pt]\special{dvisvgm:raw <metadata data-graph-strokes="1"/>}\coordinate (A) at (0,0);\coordinate (B) at (4,0);\coordinate (C) at (4,1.951);\draw (A)--(B)--node[right]{$8\text{ cm}$}(C)--node[above left]{$a\text{ cm}$}(A);\pic[draw,line width=0.4pt,angle radius=2mm]{right angle=A--B--C};\node at (1.5,0.34) {$26^\circ$};\end{tikzpicture}

spec.description: Horizontal base, vertical right leg, right angle at bottom right, reference angle at bottom left.
spec.mathematics: Opposite side 8 cm; angle 26 degrees; hypotenuse a cm.

answer.worked:
Use sine: opposite and hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\sin26^\circ&=\frac{8}{a}\\a\sin26^\circ&=8\\a&=\frac{8}{\sin26^\circ}\\a&\approx18.2494\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:
